title: A century of Muny, and the steps ahead
subtitle: UT owns the land; the City has run the course since 1937
alt: Timeline of Lions Municipal Golf Course, from the City of Austin and Community Impact: the course opened in 1924 on University of Texas land; the City took over the lease in 1937; in 1950 it became the first public golf course in the South to integrate; the City and UT signed the Brackenridge Development Agreement in 1989; on October 14, 2026 the City announced it is close to a deal to take ownership; the Environmental Commission hears it October 21, the Planning Commission October 27, and the City Council takes it up November 19.
